paragraphs: 911 Tech sells one software system that an agency uses in place of multiple apps, spreadsheets and paper forms. The company says the software was designed by cops for cops, with the aim of making the job easier.

The software is organized into four management areas. One module tracks vehicles, covering inspections, work orders, damage documentation, maintenance and history. A quartermaster module issues equipment, requires signatures and tracks inventory quantities, with self-service request and acknowledgment workflows for employees. Range qualification can be documented on an iPad, including a photo of the target. Everything on the module list except the public portal is included in one flat rate.

The software is hosted on Amazon Web Services CJIS compliant Gov Cloud. 911 Tech is an official 2026 FBINAA Strategic Alliance Partner. A prior agency training supervisor developed the training tracking module. Support runs around the clock through an online user manual, training and a support desk.

quote.text: Our software was designed by cops for cops and everything we build is designed to make your job easier.
